description: Run one already-configured enrichment column and persist its waterfall results in the sheet. Takes the exact enrichment column id (as the sheet's rows list it) and optionally the row ids to process; without them, the first 25 rows that have any value. For several columns pass columnIds: they run in order, company domain, LinkedIn, work e-mail, then phone or WhatsApp, each reading what the one before found. A contact's reveal column id (system:reveal:linkedinUrl, system:reveal:email or system:reveal:phone) runs that contact's enrichment column, added first when the sheet has none. A column runs the field it was set up with; a personal contact column (a person's mobile, personal e-mail, a partner's phone by CNPJ, a decision maker's contacts, a manager by role) and system:reveal:phone look up that personal data for each row. Can spend enrichment credits; the result's creditsCharged says how many.

columnId.description: One enrichment column, or a contact column's revealColumnId. Use columnIds for several.

columnIds.description: Several enrichment columns, run in dependency order (domain, LinkedIn, e-mail, phone).

confirmed.description: True only after the user said yes to this run's quote.

force.description: Look up again the rows that already hold the field. Only on the user's explicit ask.
